name: 7-Zip
summary: A free, open-source file archiver for Windows with its own high-compression 7z format and support for many common archive types.
description: 7-Zip is a long-running file archiver for Windows. It creates and extracts archives in its own 7z format, which is designed for a high compression ratio, and it also works with widely used formats such as ZIP, TAR and GZIP.

It adds commands to the Windows Explorer context menu, includes a simple file manager, and offers a command-line version for scripts and automation. 7z and ZIP archives can be protected with AES-256 encryption.
The official website publishes separate installers for 64-bit (x64), 32-bit (x86) and ARM64 Windows, plus alternative MSI packages for managed deployment.

name: AF Media Bar
summary: A taskbar media controller that shows media information, lyrics and playback controls directly on the desktop.
description: AF Media Bar adds a media control bar to the Windows taskbar. It reads the current system media session and displays track info, lyrics, playback buttons and device switching in a convenient panel.

AF Media Bar is a lightweight utility for Windows desktops. It extracts information from the system media session, so any media player that integrates with Windows can be controlled. The bar shows the current track title, artist, album art and optional lyrics. Users can play, pause, skip tracks, adjust volume and switch output devices without opening the player. The interface can be customized, supports multiple languages and offers both an installer and a portable version. Settings are stored in the user’s local app data and can be edited manually. The program runs without telemetry, ads or account requirements, though it can check for updates and fetch online lyrics when enabled. It includes the required .NET runtime and uses Microsoft Edge WebView2 for rendering.

name: BleachBit
summary: BleachBit is a system cleaner that removes unnecessary files to free disk space and protect privacy.
description: BleachBit scans your computer for temporary files, caches, logs and other junk that can be safely deleted. It lets you preview what will be removed and then delete it, helping to keep the system tidy and protect personal information.

BleachBit works on Windows and Linux. It offers a graphical interface where you can select which types of data to clean, such as web browser caches, system logs, temporary files, and more. You can run it as a portable program without installing, or use the installer for a standard setup. The program includes many built‑in cleaners and also supports custom cleaner definitions. It provides options for secure file deletion to make recovered data difficult. The interface allows you to preview files before deletion and to configure preferences for automatic cleaning tasks.

name: Headroom Desktop
summary: Headroom Desktop is a tray application that reduces token usage for Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex and similar AI coding tools by about half.
description: Headroom Desktop runs in the system tray and intercepts requests from supported coding assistants. It compresses prompts and responses locally, letting the same AI plan cover more work without changing how you code.

The app installs a managed Python runtime isolated from the system and adds a local proxy between your coding client and the LLM API. It applies token‑saving transformations to prompts, logs and boilerplate, then forwards the optimized request to the service. After the response is returned, the original content can be reconstructed on demand. Headroom shows charts of daily and monthly token savings, per‑client statistics, and health information. It works on Windows, macOS and Linux (preview) and requires a Headroom account with an active subscription, though the desktop shell itself is open source under the MIT license.

name: KeePassXC
summary: A free, open-source password manager that keeps your passwords in an encrypted database file you control.
description: KeePassXC is a community-developed, cross-platform password manager. It stores passwords, notes and other credentials in a single encrypted database file that stays on your device or in a storage location you choose, rather than in a vendor's cloud account.

It uses the KDBX database format, so databases can also be opened by other KeePass-compatible applications. Features include a password and passphrase generator, Auto-Type for filling in login forms, and optional browser integration through the KeePassXC-Browser extension.

On Windows, the official download page offers installers and portable ZIP packages for x64 and ARM64 PCs running Windows 10 or 11. A separate legacy installer for Windows 7, 8 and 8.1 is tied to an older release that is no longer supported.

name: Notepad++

description: Notepad++ is a lightweight source code and text editor built specifically for Windows. It opens many files in tabs, highlights syntax for a wide range of programming and markup languages, and can fold code blocks to make long files easier to read.

name: OBS Studio
summary: Free and open-source software for screen recording and live streaming, built around scenes, sources and an audio mixer.
description: OBS Studio (Open Broadcaster Software) is used to record video and to stream live to supported platforms. You build scenes from sources such as screen and window capture, webcams, images, browser sources and audio inputs, then switch between them while recording or streaming.

It includes an audio mixer with per-source filters, a studio mode for previewing scenes before they go live, configurable hotkeys and support for third-party plugins. Hardware-accelerated encoding is available on supported graphics cards.
Recording and streaming are demanding tasks, so check the official release notes and your graphics driver version before upgrading.

name: ShareX
summary: A free, open-source screen capture, screen recording and file-sharing tool for Windows with configurable after-capture workflows.
description: ShareX captures your screen in many ways: a selected region, a window, the full screen or a scrolling page. It can also record the screen as a video or animated GIF.

Because ShareX is highly configurable, it suits both quick everyday screenshots and repeatable documentation workflows.

name: TizuMark
summary: A lightweight Markdown editor for Windows with live preview, outline navigation, KaTeX and Mermaid support.
description: TizuMark is a free, open‑source Markdown editor built with Rust and Tauri. It provides a fast, low‑memory experience and lets you write and preview documents in real time.

The program offers a WYSIWYG live preview so the formatted view is shown while you type. You can split the window horizontally or vertically to see source and preview side by side, and an automatic outline lets you jump to any heading. Mathematical formulas are rendered with KaTeX and diagrams can be created with Mermaid. Images can be pasted directly, and the editor can export to HTML, PNG, PDF and Word DOCX while keeping the current theme. Keyboard shortcuts are fully customizable, multiple tabs and workspaces are supported, and the interface is available in Chinese, English and Spanish.

name: Warpinator Windows
summary: An unofficial implementation of Warpinator for Windows.
description: Warpinator Windows lets you share files and small text messages between Windows, Linux and Android computers on the same network. It is a community‑made version of the Linux Mint tool, aimed at users who need simple local file transfers without cloud services.

The program recreates the basic functionality of the original Warpinator tool: you can browse nearby devices, send files or folders, and receive incoming transfers. It works on Windows 7 and newer, and includes a portable ZIP version for users who prefer not to install anything. The interface shows a list of discovered peers, a transfer queue, and recent transfer history. The project is open source under GPL‑3.0 and is maintained by volunteers. It also warns users about fake websites that try to distribute malicious copies.
The software is built with .NET and can be installed via the provided EXE installer or run directly from the portable ZIP. A winget package is also available for automatic installation.
The latest update adds the ability to send and receive short text messages, improves folder handling, and fixes several UI and security issues.
